piece_type: DTC patient testimonial video (animated 'Patient Ambassador Video')
regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)
note: Text read via Exa fetch of fda.gov PDF.

cases.claim: “Everything was difficult.” | “… I learned about an FDA approved treatment called Turalio.” | “It really made me feel beyond hopeful.” | “I don’t know what the future holds, but I’m optimistic.”
cases.context: Animated flashback: vines pull patient down, dark garden; dragonfly frees her, vines retreat and disappear, she returns to gardening. ORR 38% at Week 25 (15% CR). Disclaimer 'Outcomes may vary...' does not mitigate.
cases.rationale: Totality suggests all patients will have complete resolution and return to pre-diagnosis activities.
cases.check: Do before/after visuals or testimonials imply complete resolution or return to normal life beyond the response rates in the PI?

cases.claim: From feeling that “everything was difficult” to “it really made me feel beyond hopeful”; vines unable to grab her; she picks up her basket to return to gardening.
cases.context: PROMIS-PF and Worst Stiffness NRS secondary endpoints uninterpretable due to 43% missing data; mood, lighting and music shift reinforce impression. Product has Boxed Warning for hepatotoxicity.
cases.rationale: Implies improved emotional and physical functioning / HRQoL not demonstrated.
cases.check: Does the piece imply HRQoL, emotional or physical-function benefit when PRO data are absent or uninterpretable?
